description: Approved by the user (relayed by Elixir Parity, 2026-11-20) in the fz-mue.12 amendment, which chose a full %Macro.Env{} for __CALLER__ and __ENV__ (field table in /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.12.html). Until this lands versioned_vars is %{} because fz's expander does not track variables. Done: the expander tracks the variables bound at the macro call site, and Macro.Env.versioned_vars, Macro.Env.vars/1 and Macro.Env.has_var?/2 answer as Elixir does. Owner: Elixir Parity.
title: The macro expander knows the caller's variables, so Macro.Env.versioned_vars, vars/1 and has_var?/2 are as in Elixir
